title: Japan urges US to tighten discipline after another Marine arrested
summary: Japan has asked the United States to thoroughly enforce discipline after a U.S. Marine in Okinawa Prefecture was arrested for allegedly driving under the influence of alcohol during curfew hours…

blocks.text: Japan has asked the United States to thoroughly enforce discipline after a U.S. Marine in Okinawa Prefecture was arrested for allegedly driving under the influence of alcohol during curfew hours imposed following a murder case involving another Marine, Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said Monday. Koizumi said he wants the U.S. side to “take seriously” the fact that the incident occurred despite the curfew period starting Oct. 9 in response to the arrest on Oct. 4 of Devin Ballard, who was subsequently indicted on charges of robbing and murdering a local woman in Naha, the capital of the southern island prefecture.
